translation: Flavor bitter, slightly cold, non-toxic. It governs impotence in men (男子陰痿), dampness below the scrotum (囊下濕), dribbling after urination (小便余瀝), itching of the genitals in women (女人陰癢) and pain of the low back and spine (腰脊痛), wind-weakness and pain of both feet (兩腳疼風弱), the five slownesses (五緩), deficiency and emaciation (虛羸), supplements the center and benefits essence (補中益精), strengthens the sinews and bones (堅筋骨), and strengthens the will and intention (強志意). Taken for a long time...
